messages.subject: issue-69 research plan written
messages.body: Plan written at .m4/issue-69-plan.md: three new contract families at 0.4.0 (storage-engine profile, storage-introspection evidence, storage-migration-plan) plus an additive storage-projection v0.4.0 bump (defaults, enum/array, partial indexes, checks), a new storage_engine core module with an embedded PostgreSQL profile (version matrix, type table, quoting, lock/isolation snapshot), a lekalo storage CLI group, conformance battery, fixtures/docs/scripts, and explicit shared seams for #117. Biggest risk: the storage-projection 0.4.0 member additions force per-namespace policy decisions (laravel answers for enum/array/partial-index) and the plan recommends explicit refusals over silent coercion, which needs owner sign-off. What is left: coordinator review of the recommended decisions in section 6 before implementation dispatch.
